queries.query: Egypt official cadastral map parcel service Al Qusiya Assiut land registry GIS; Al Qusiya Egypt cadastral map parcels survey authority
queries.result: Found the official Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA) site and its map/service pages. ESA describes production of paper and digital maps showing land ownership/parcels, but no public Al Qusiya parcel viewer/API was found. Search also found an official environmental-planning PDF with a general land-use map of Al Qusiya, not cadastral parcel data.

queries.query: القوصية أسيوط خريطة مساحية قطع الأراضي الهيئة المصرية العامة للمساحة؛ القوصية أسيوط السجل العيني خرائط كادسترية
queries.result: Found the official ESA Arabic site and general Egyptian cadastral/topographic-map service descriptions, plus non-parcel planning/legal references for Al Qusiya. No first-party public Al Qusiya cadastral map/API or anonymous parcel response was found.

localCustodian.name: Egyptian Survey Authority / Assiut local survey administration (local Al Qusiya custodian not independently evidenced)
localCustodian.evidence: ESA is the first-party national survey authority and states that it produces maps and databases showing private land ownership/parcels and supports land registration. The public pages inspected did not expose a city-specific Al Qusiya parcel endpoint or schema.

generalAgency.name: Egyptian Survey Authority (national/general agency)
generalAgency.scope: General paper/digital/topographic map and survey services; not evidence of an anonymously queryable Al Qusiya cadastral service.

runtimeReadiness.reason: No independently qualified Al Qusiya adapter or citywide parcel source was evidenced.
